Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Keep all seven people, the green door, the animal pictures, the school bag with its round bump, and the floor as thick, closed outlines. Every person keeps a face with two eyes with pupils and a mouth. Draw each head of hair as one closed shape. Simplify the background: draw only a few large, simple, closed shapes. No small details, no grass blades, no small leaves, no hatching, no tick marks, no wood grain lines. Every shape is closed with one thick line. The outline of each object (a branch, a leaf cluster, a bag, a table, a tree) is one closed shape that does not run into a hill line or a floor line. Use few background shapes and no bushes or hills that are not needed. Trace only what is in picture 1. Each eye outline is one closed ring with a solid pupil. An open mouth stays open. Draw every waving hand with five closed finger outlines. Keep every shape of picture 1: a rectangular rug stays rectangular, a round rug stays round. An open mouth is one closed outline with the inner mouth shape inside it (the tongue or teeth line); it never becomes a single smile curve. Each eye is a closed outer ring with a solid black pupil inside it; never a solid dot alone. No rib lines, stripes, or texture lines on shoes or clothes, except a shirt stripe that the color picture shows. Draw each hand as a closed outline with each finger as a separate rounded shape. Every outline is one closed line; no loose line ends anywhere. The ear is one closed outline with at most one inner curve. Draw every raised hand with five separate closed finger outlines (four fingers and one thumb).
